phrases.Alle Systeme auf einen Blick – ohne Clou: All systems at a glance — without cloud lock-in.
phrases.Urlaubsmodus ein- oder ausschalten: Turn Vacation mode on or off

phrases.Virtuelle Geräte lokal in SALTA anlegen: Create virtual devices locally in SALTA and expose them through the SALTA HomeKit bridge.
phrases.SALTA unterstützt virtuelle Schalter und: SALTA supports virtual switches and self-resetting buttons. Both can be triggered through HomeKit and used in automations.
phrases.Erkenne Personen lokal anhand bekannter: Detect people locally using known Wi‑Fi MAC addresses and use presence directly in SALTA automations.

phrases.Hostname oder IP-Adresse ohne Protokoll: Hostname or IP address without protocol and port.
phrases.Nur für HTTPS. Erlaubt selbstsignierte F: HTTPS only. Allows self-signed FRITZ!Box certificates. Enable only if you trust your local FRITZ!Box.
phrases.Aus allen überwachten Personen erzeugt S: SALTA also creates a combined household presence state from all monitored people.
phrases.„Anwesend“, „Jemand zuhause“ und „Nieman: “Present”, “Someone home” and “Nobody home” are available as triggers or conditions.
phrases.Verwende die MAC-Adresse, die deine FRIT: Use the MAC address shown by your FRITZ!Box for the phone on your home Wi‑Fi.

phrases.Dieser Name wird in der Übersicht bei an: This name is shown on the overview when the person is present.
phrases.Auch Bindestriche, Cisco-Notation oder e: Hyphens, Cisco notation and MAC addresses without separators are also accepted.
phrases.Bei Smartphones sollte die für dieses He: For smartphones, the private MAC used for this home Wi‑Fi should remain stable. A short absence delay prevents false changes caused by Wi‑Fi roaming or power-saving modes.
phrases.Reagiere lokal auf Geräteereignisse und: React locally to device events and control other devices based on their current state.
phrases.Eine Regel wird bei einem echten Zustand: A rule runs on a real state change, a received button event, or daily at a configured time.
phrases.Definiere einen oder mehrere Auslöser, b: Define one or more triggers, up to eight AND-linked conditions and up to eight target actions.
phrases.Name: Name
phrases.Mehrere Ereignisse werden ODER-verknüpft: Multiple events are linked with OR.
phrases.Ordne Geräte früh und eindeutig nach Ber: Organize devices clearly by areas of your home.

phrases.Lege einen Namen fest und wähle ein pass: Enter a name and choose a suitable room icon.

phrases.Sobald DEBUG aktiv ist, zeigt SALTA den: When DEBUG is enabled, SALTA permanently shows the current level in the header. Pushover credentials are still managed under “Notifications”.
phrases.Farbprofile auswählen oder jede zentrale: Select color profiles or customize every central SALTA color individually.
phrases.Die Sprache gilt nur für diesen Browser: The language applies only to this browser or device. “Automatic” uses the browser’s preferred language.
phrases.Ein Profil setzt die komplette helle und: A profile sets the complete light and dark palettes. Changing a single color automatically switches SALTA to “Custom”.
phrases.Änderungen werden sofort als Vorschau an: Changes are previewed immediately. They are saved only with “Save appearance”. The Light/Dark switch in the sidebar remains independent.
phrases.Globale Standardwerte. Jedes Gerät kann: Global defaults. Each device can override these credentials or operate without authentication.
phrases.Leer lassen, um beizubehalten: Leave blank to keep current value

phrases.Alternativ kann SALTA nach Freigabe in P: Alternatively, SALTA can request a key automatically after authorization in Phoscon.

phrases.Klicke innerhalb von 60 Sekunden hier au: Within 60 seconds, click “Request API key” here.
phrases.Verbinde SALTA lokal über die Hue API v2: Connect SALTA locally through Hue API v2. Phoscon remains completely independent.
phrases.IP-Adresse oder Hostname der lokalen Hue: IP address or hostname of the local Hue Bridge. SALTA uses HTTPS only.
phrases.Drücke den runden Link-Button auf der Ph: Press the round link button on the Philips Hue Bridge.
phrases.SALTA erzeugt und speichert einen eigene: SALTA creates and stores its own local application key.

phrases.Aktueller Zustand der HAP-Bridge und der: Current state of the HAP bridge and device publishing.
phrases.QR-Code scannen oder den numerischen Pai: Scan the QR code or use the numeric pairing code.
phrases.Unterstützte SALTA-Geräte direkt für App: Publish supported SALTA devices directly to Apple Home.

phrases.verwendet die hier gespeicherte Betriebs: uses the operating mode saved here. Global Heating mode remains a SALTA-only feature and is not exposed to HomeKit.
phrases.SALTA fasst alle aktuell niedrigen Batte: SALTA combines all currently low battery states and sends at most one Pushover warning within seven days.
phrases.Nur senden, wenn mindestens ein Gerät un: Send only when at least one device is below the threshold or reports Low Battery.
phrases.Geräte mit explizitem Low-Battery-Status: Devices with an explicit Low Battery state are included regardless of percentage.
phrases.Erstellt eine passwortverschlüsselte Dis: Creates a password-encrypted disaster-recovery file for a comprehensive SALTA rebuild.
phrases.Sichert Konfiguration, verschlüsselte Zu: Backs up configuration, encrypted credentials, SALTA runtime keys, administrator access and HomeKit pairing state in one file.
phrases.Das Backup-Passwort wird nicht in SALTA: The backup password is not stored in SALTA. Without it, the file cannot be restored.
phrases.Verbinde SALTA über die lokale JSON-RPC-: Connect SALTA to OpenCCU through the local JSON-RPC interface.
phrases.Verwende möglichst einen eigenen OpenCCU: Use a dedicated OpenCCU user for SALTA if possible.
phrases.Gerät manuell verbinden oder im lokalen: Connect a device manually or find it on the local network.

phrases.Für Shellys ohne aktivierten Zugangsschu: For Shelly devices without enabled access protection.

Addresses .1 through .254 are checked. This can take a few seconds.
phrases.Lege einen virtuellen Schalter oder selb: Create a virtual switch or self-resetting button for SALTA and HomeKit.
phrases.Ein Taster wird in HomeKit schaltbar ber: A button is exposed as switchable in HomeKit and automatically resets to Off after being triggered.
phrases.Name, Raum und Gerätefunktion konfigurie: Configure name, room and device function.
phrases.Lege fest, wo das Gerät angezeigt wird: Choose where the device is shown

phrases.Das Gerät bleibt auf der Zigbee-Seite gr: The device remains visible in gray on the Zigbee page and is not exposed to HomeKit.
phrases.Beim Taster wird jeder Ein-Impuls nach 5: For a button, every On pulse automatically resets to Off after 500 ms. Existing automations and HomeKit assignments remain intact.
phrases.Das Shelly-Gerät selbst wird nicht zurüc: The Shelly device itself is not reset or switched off. It can be added again later.
phrases.Hue-Geräte werden standardmäßig nicht er: Hue devices are not republished to HomeKit by default, preventing duplicate devices when the Hue Bridge is already connected directly to Apple Home. SALTA HomeKit publishing can be enabled per device.
phrases.Öffne auf iPhone oder iPad die Home-App: On an iPhone or iPad, open the Home app → “+” → “Add Accessory” and scan the QR code.
phrases.SALTA speichert den gewünschten Zielraum: SALTA stores the desired target room per device. Apple Home determines the actual room assignment during pairing; SALTA cannot reliably enforce it through HAP.
phrases.Nur nötig, wenn dieses Gerät ausnahmswei: Only required if this device should use a different SALTA room as its HomeKit target.
phrases.SALTA speichert den gewünschten Zielraum: SALTA already stores the desired target room centrally. The current HAP bridge cannot technically enforce Apple Home room assignments; the setting is retained as prepared HomeKit configuration for later pairing.
phrases.„Speichern und testen“ prüft Anmeldung u: “Save and test” checks authentication and interfaces. Diagnostics then show whether each OpenCCU method succeeded or returned an error such as a Tcl error. Technical details are also written to the system log.
